promises.quote: The training for CCTV operators encompasses modules that cover behavioural body language training and are specifically designed to detect behaviours that would fall under the remit of 'suspicious'. The training is based on established principles and techniques outlined in Tavcom training programs - suspicious behaviours can include gestures, mannerisms, alone or in a group, time, location, how someone is acting (i.e. drunk/disorientated), approaching people, being aggressive etc. The training given
promises.summary: Introduce annual mandatory refresher training for CCTV operators on suspicious behaviour

promises.quote: We accept that the Probation Delivery Unit (PDU) responsible for Jordan McSweeney was understaffed at the time. Whilst at a national level, the staffing position of the Probation Service is improving, I acknowledge that raising staffing in this PDU to its full complement remains a significant challenge. Therefore, until such time as the situation improves, in this PDU and others with acute pressure remaining, staff will follow a Prioritisation Framework which we first implemented in January 2022
promises.summary: Implement Prioritisation Framework to manage staffing pressures

concerns.quote: The probation delivery unit responsible for the offender was understaffed at the time of relevant oversight

links.explanation: Both reports highlight insufficient staffing in the probation service as a safety concern. The earlier report links staffing shortages to recruitment and retention problems due to low pay, while the later report describes current understaffing levels affecting supervision and risk assessment.
